items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: After Reb Spikes left, George Brown took it over around '28

ctx.x: Tell us a little bit about the shows; what they were like.

Well, they were burlesque shows, you know, they had strippers and I can remember when Reb Spikes opened up the Follies, I was supposed to go with him. After Reb Spikes left, George Brown took it over around '28, and then
Dalton wanted to open up another burlesque because it was going so good up there, and that was the Burbank Theater at Sixth and Main. That's when I started with them, January, 1929.
